verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's own Entity Management API supports bulk retrieval: up to 100 UEIs per query, an API Extract for bulk retrieval, and JSON/CSV output of up to 1,000,000 records. These are read-only bulk queries and exports, not bulk actions that modify many items at once. missing for 10: bulk write/update/action operations across items, documented batch job semantics or limits beyond extract size, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Allows a single 12-character value or up to 100 values.
It returns data in the JSON or CSV format as selected by the user. It can return only the first 1,000,000 records.
an API Extract for bulk retrieval
